Prototype: brug ikke løsningen til følso: Prototype: avoid sensitive situations. Encryption does not protect against a compromised phone, PC or client code.
Ingen brugerkonto er nødvendig. Sammenli: No user account is needed. Always compare the code before accepting.
Telefonklienten hentes fra Cloudflare. O: The phone client is loaded from Cloudflare. Compromised hosting or deployment access could change the client and leak video. The packaged Windows UI reduces this dependency on the PC, but does not protect the phone client.
Installationen er usigneret og kræver ad: The installer is unsigned and requests administrator approval. A fake or replaced installer can compromise the PC. Download only from the project’s official GitHub Release. A checksum on the same account does not protect against takeover of that entire account.
QR-koden og parringslinket indeholder ad: The QR code and pairing link contain access secrets. Do not share or publish them. One-time tokens, expiry and the comparison code reduce risk, but a leaked invitation and mistaken approval can still connect the wrong device. The code is not an account login or a guarantee of identity.
Malware, administratorer eller en person: Malware, administrators or a person with access to an unlocked phone or PC may read the screen, keys or video. Encryption in transit does not protect compromised endpoints. Do not use this prototype where a video leak would have serious consequences.
Afkodede billeder passerer en midlertidi: Decoded frames pass through a temporary file under ProgramData. It is access-controlled, cleared and deleted on close, but is not anonymous RAM only. Processes under the same user or with sufficient system privileges may gain access. Deletion does not guarantee secure erasure of disk or pagefile data.
Server- og beskedgrænser dæmper misbrug,: Server and message limits reduce abuse, but requests still reach Cloudflare. A larger attack can exhaust quotas and block new pairings. An already paired malicious device can also disrupt the session. This does not by itself give an outsider access to video.
Cloudflare og GitHub kan behandle IP-adr: Cloudflare and GitHub may process IP addresses and technical connection data. WebRTC exchanges network information between devices. No user account is required, but the service is not anonymous. Shared Wi-Fi is not a security guarantee; guest isolation, firewalls and interruptions can block the connection.

Kameraet forsøger at starte efter pc-acc: The camera attempts to start after PC approval once browser permission is granted. Watch the camera indicator and disconnect after use. Funktionstest og et npm-opslag er ikke e: Functional tests and an npm advisory check are not penetration testing, fuzzing or a guarantee. Native C++, WebView2 and system components may contain unknown flaws; serious flaws could potentially compromise a process. Keep Windows, browser and app updated. The phone client updates online; the local Windows UI requires a new app version.

En invitation gælder i 10 minutter. Annu: An invitation lasts 10 minutes. Cancel and create a new pairing or reopen the app. Use the same ordinary Wi-Fi; guest networks may isolate devices. A VPN or firewall can block WebRTC. Try a trusted network without disabling security protection globally. Open the link in Safari or Chrome, not an embedded scanner browser. Error 429 means too many attempts: wait and retry.

Keep the copyright and licence notice in copies or substantial portions. The software comes without warranty. Third-party code and fonts have their own included licences; the extruda logo and brand assets are not covered by the code’s MIT licence.
Ja. Prototypen er udviklet med AI-assist: Yes. The prototype was developed with AI-assisted programming (vibe coding) and Codex, guided by the owner’s requests and iterative testing. Code and documentation may contain mistakes or overlooked assumptions even when automated tests pass. This is not an independent code review or security certification. Opret et GitHub-issue med appversion, Wi: Open a GitHub issue with the app version, Windows version, phone/browser and reproduction steps. Telefonens kameraside leveres fra vores: Your phone’s camera page comes from our website. Someone who takes over access to change the website could change what the page does.
En angriber kan i værste fald få siden t: In the worst case, an attacker could make the page send your camera image to someone else while you use it. Encryption does not help if the page itself has been changed.
Du giver installationsprogrammet lov til: You allow the installer to make changes to Windows. Windows cannot yet verify its publisher using a digital signature.
Henter du en falsk udgave, kan den i vær: A fake copy could, in the worst case, install malware, steal files or take over your PC. Use the project’s official GitHub download; the correct filename alone does not prove a file is genuine.
QR-koden er en midlertidig invitation me: The QR code is a temporary invitation containing a secret key. Someone who gets a picture of it or the link itself can try to use that invitation.
Hvis du samtidig accepterer uden at samm: If you also accept without comparing the code on both devices, you could connect an unfamiliar device. Images from the wrong phone could then appear in your meeting. A leaked QR code alone does not grant access to your phone camera, but you should never share it.
Hvis telefonen eller pc’en allerede har: If the phone or PC already has malware, or someone can use your unlocked device, they may be able to see what you see.
Private billeder, parringsnøgler eller s: Private images, pairing secrets or screen contents could be copied without your knowledge. The app’s encryption cannot make an already compromised phone or PC safe again.
For at vise videoen som et Windows-kamer: To present video as a Windows camera, the app briefly puts images in a protected temporary file on the PC. This is not a normal video recording, but the images briefly exist outside the app itself.
Et andet program med dine brugerrettighe: Another program with your user permissions or administrator access might copy the images. Traces may also remain on storage after the file is deleted. Avoid images for which even a possible leak would be serious.
Parringen bruger en fælles onlinetjenest: Pairing uses a shared online service with limited capacity. Many requests or abuse can make the service temporarily unavailable.
Du kan stå lige før et møde uden at kunn: You might be unable to connect your phone just before a meeting. A session could also be interrupted or disrupted. An outage does not itself mean anyone has seen your images; consider keeping the PC’s ordinary webcam as a backup.
Selv uden login efterlader brugen teknis: Even without a login, use leaves technical traces such as your internet address. Two devices on the same Wi-Fi may also be prevented from communicating.
Tjenesteudbydere kan have oplysninger om: Service providers may have connection information, and the solution does not make you anonymous. Guest Wi-Fi or network rules can prevent pairing. This connection information is not the same as access to the camera image itself.
Når du accepterer på pc’en og har tillad: Once you accept on the PC and have allowed the browser to use the camera, the phone attempts to send video. An app or person able to see the image on the PC can save it.
Du kan komme til at vise et privat rum e: You could accidentally show a private room or people you did not intend to film. Images could be recorded or shared further even though Extruda has no record button. Point the camera appropriately before accepting, then disconnect and close the page after use.
Vi har afprøvet bestemte funktioner, men: We have tested specific functions, but no independent expert has reviewed the entire solution for security holes. There may still be flaws we do not know about.
En fejl kan give sort billede eller nedb: A bug could cause black video or a crash. In the worst case, a serious security flaw could let an attacker read data or run malicious code on a device. These are possible consequences, not a claim that such a hole has been found. Keep the app, Windows and browser updated.
AI har hjulpet med at skrive programmet: AI helped write the program and its guides. AI can produce something that looks correct but still contains mistakes.
En vejledning kan vise en forkert menu,: A guide could name the wrong menu, a feature could fail or a security flaw could be overlooked. A passing test or convincing text is not proof of security. Avoid use where a leaked image or an outage could have serious consequences.
Denne version kræver internet til telefo: This version needs internet for the phone client and pairing, even on the same Wi-Fi. Video and optional microphone audio travel directly using WebRTC; Cloudflare does not relay media. The microphone starts off for every new connection and needs a tap and browser permission on the phone. The app has no recording feature, but meeting apps and receivers can save video and sound. Disconnect and close both sides after use. Never share the QR code or link. See Security risks.
